name: Usage Tracker
description: Tracks daily token usage per provider/model and auto-switches provider when budget is exceeded.

usageFile.description: Path to the usage tracking JSON file

dailyInputTokenLimit.description: Max input tokens per day (0 = disabled)

dailyTokenLimit.description: Max total tokens per day (0 = disabled)

maxHistoryDays.description: Days of usage history to retain (default: 30)

fallbackProvider.description: Provider ID to switch to when limit is reached

fallbackModel.description: Model ID to use with fallback provider
